need: Publish a polished searchable static catalog from authoritative Markdown and JSON without building a frontend or hosted service.

discovery.stop_condition: A Python-aligned static generator supplied responsive navigation, tags, client search, preview, and Pages output behind a removable development boundary.

contenders.name: MkDocs or Material
evidence: new integration transition cost is higher for this release

contenders.name: Hugo
evidence: separate Go toolchain without measured advantage

contenders.name: Pagefind
evidence: fallback only if measured built-in search fails

hard_gates: source JSON and Markdown remain complete
unknowns: Pre-1.0 compatibility beyond the exact tested release.
Search relevance at the synthetic 5000-entry scale until benchmarked.
decision_effect: Pin and test Zensical 0.0.62 only in development/site workflows; keep public export independent and record a removal boundary at zensical.toml plus Pages build steps.
reconsider_when: The exact version cannot build deterministically
Client search misses the measured corpus target
The project changes license or network behavior
